cases.causal_structure: Two sites; correction relaxes latency, but one rollback remains untested and approval is requested only.
cases.counterfactual: Completion of both missing prerequisites changes to GO.

cases.causal_structure: Service recovery requires two independent probes after a restart; duplicate old failures share an origin; both new probes pass and authorization is current.
cases.counterfactual: Withdraw one independent fresh probe to change to HOLD.

cases.causal_structure: Deletion needs a successful restore test for this exact backup generation; a passed test belongs to the preceding generation.
cases.counterfactual: Supply a matching generation restore test to change to GO.

cases.causal_structure: A revised window supersedes an earlier deadline; work fits the new window, authorization and rollback remain valid.
cases.counterfactual: Move proposed work outside the current window to change to HOLD.

cases.causal_structure: Authority is capped cumulatively; two individually permitted line items exceed the aggregate cap after a correction.
cases.counterfactual: Reduce total below the documented cap to change to GO.

cases.causal_structure: A damaged lot is excluded from a scoped shipment; every included lot has inspection and release receipts.
cases.counterfactual: Include the unapproved lot to change to HOLD.

cases.causal_structure: Export requires consent for all requested fields; one receipt covers an overlapping dataset but omits a requested field.
cases.counterfactual: Add explicit consent for the missing field to change to GO.

cases.causal_structure: A written exception removes one prerequisite only for this version/site; all remaining prerequisites are satisfied.
cases.counterfactual: Change the deployment site outside the exception to change to HOLD.

cases.causal_structure: Activation needs acknowledgement after the latest key version; several acknowledgements precede a later rotation.
cases.counterfactual: Supply latest-version acknowledgements to change to GO.

cases.causal_structure: Earlier symptoms are resolved by independent current checks and an explicit closure owner receipt; a proposed monitor is not a required closure condition.
cases.counterfactual: Withdraw the required closure receipt to change to HOLD.

cases.causal_structure: A grant requires two distinct role approvals; apparently separate reports are forwarded copies of the same approver.
cases.counterfactual: Supply the missing distinct role approval to change to GO.

cases.causal_structure: A threshold correction changes allowed aggregate error; measured error remains unchanged and lies exactly at an explicitly inclusive boundary; all provenance requirements pass.
cases.counterfactual: Change the specified relation to strict less-than to change to HOLD.
